name: Tribes Of Israel The
overview: The Tribes of Israel originate from the twelve sons of Jacob, as detailed in Genesis 35, which lists the sons born to Leah, Rachel, and their handmaids. Notably, Joseph's two sons, Ephraim and Manasseh, were adopted as tribes in place of Joseph and Levi, affirming their equal standing among the tribes (Genesis 48:5). These tribes were organized into divisions for encampment and inheritance, maintaining their distinct identities while collectively forming the nation of Israel.
